commits.subject: Add 8 UX improvements: task stats, plan mode, security lock, and more
commits.body:
- Task completion stats (turns, cost, duration) shown after every task
- Plan mode content display: read and send plan file before approval
- /plan command: force plan mode for the next message
- Plan rejection feedback: text input for revision requests
- CLI session handoff: detect active sessions on /new and startup
- Progress notifications: periodic updates during long tasks (2min)
- Security lock: /lock and /unlock with PIN-based bot locking
- Table rendering: auto-convert markdown tables to code blocks for Telegram
- Launcher: improved Node.js path detection with full PATH resolution
- README: updated with all new features and comparison with Claude Code Remote Control
